Velixir says
Env vars are injected at pod start. Save changes here and then redeploy this app to roll the new values out to every replica. Secret values are encrypted at rest and masked in this UI; to change one, just set it again. 
I have added the following key value pairs in the dashboard for zen dot velixir dot run
Key 	Value 	Type 	Actions
postgresconnectionstring 	postgresql://{user}:{password}@{host}:{port}/{database} 	
postgresdatabase 	{database} 	
postgreshost 	{host} 	
postgrespassword 	{password} 	
postgresport 	{port} 	
postgresuser 	{user} 	 
some details about this database 
it is on a free dev tier at clever-cloud dot com 
it uses postgresql 18 
it allows up to five connections 
processor and memory are shared 
disk size is 256MB 
so you can imagine, very basic specs
however, it still gives us enough to build a demo project 
we will build a new set of web api endpoints 
and a new page to show the results of this web api endpoints
and to explain how to use the API endpoints 
there is no authentication needed to use these endpoints
the web api endpoint will accept http post 
and return a uuid-v7 guid or something 
and then the client will be able to get what they sent us with the guid with http get
if it still exists with us otherwise they will get a 404 not found
there should also be aggregate endpoints 
where clients can get aggregate all the data they have sent us 
based on their referer and their key
it will record the header, body, referer, all the information that the client sends 
and it presents it on the page 
each post request has a very generoud body limit maybe 10k characters or something obscenely large
the idea is to use this small database 
but old data still gets removed 
so we stay within the limits 
and as always both the web api and the page should work somewhat even if the database connection is not working 
we will lose state for some time but we should be back when the backend becomes available again 
resilience is key 
as for the uses of these new endpoints 
think demonstrating analytics, csp report only, page visit count, page visitor reaction count, or anything else 
somehow we also need to delete older entries as the database fills up before it is FULL 
we are stuck with dotnet 10 for now so we have to use packages that work with dotnet 10 
use dapper where necessary 
avoid ef core 
also there might be nuget packages and github actions 
and other dependencies that we can upgrade to latest stable as well
upgrade them all 
as we do all of this 
please be mindful to use best engineering practices 
and solid principles 
Use your best judgment
If only a few files (under five or there about) need to change, give me the full path of the files that need to change and the FULL file 
if there are a lot of files that need to change
